ycy git heat
Show frequently changed files and directories in recent commits
Usage:
  ycy git heat [flags]
Flags:
  -d, --days	Number of recent days to inspect
  -h, --help	help for heat
  -n, --limit	Number of recent commits to inspect
  -q, --query	Highlight files or directories that contain text
  -r, --relative-time	Show Changed at as relative time
  -s, --sort	Sort by count or path
  -t, --type	Report type: files or directories
  --log-format	Diagnostic format: text or json
  --log-level	Log level: debug, info, warn, or error
  --quiet	Only emit error diagnostics (short form: -q)
  -v, --verbose	Enable debug diagnostics
